title: Payment Methods for Northgate+ Membership Fees
content:
Desk note on the payment method of a Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships membership.

**Rule.** Paid membership fees are charged to either a Northgate Card account or an external debit or credit card. A Northgate Card can be set as the payment method only when that card account belongs to the same customer and is in active status. A card that is suspended, closed or charged off cannot be used. A payment method change applies to the next fee attempt, including a retry during a payment hold. Northgate Rewards has no payment method.

**Basis of judgement.** The card's owner and status are read from the Northgate Card account record that is being set as the payment method.

| Northgate Card account | Belongs to the same customer | Status | May be set as the fee payment method |
|---|---|---|---|
| hypothetical account A | yes | active | yes |
| hypothetical account B | yes | suspended, closed or charged off | no |
| hypothetical account C | no | active | no |

**Basis Q&A**

*A member on payment hold switches the fee to an external card.* The change applies to the next fee attempt, including the next retry during the hold.
